svg.text: private, no public addresses; default route via the bastion
jail: TLS for vikunja, zulip, sylve,
VM: Zulip, reached through the proxy
cloud disk: WireGuard and ssh host keys
cloud disk: every jail's data, encrypted
ssh to every server, https to the web UIs

g.text: Boxes: brick wall, orange = firewall, one row per rule. Blue outline with a network sign = network
(a container: what is inside is on it). Green with a screen = server or VM. Violet with a cube =
jail, inside its server's network. Red with a drive = cloud disk. Laptop = peer outside the project.
Folded page = DNS zone. Circle = the internet. Plain grey = cloud project, or a group.
Lines: thick blue dashed = WireGuard tunnel; solid = traffic, labelled protocol and port; dotted = a
